{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue column - is it string? Are there commas?
print(f"Revenue dtype: {df['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded.shape[0]}")

# Check unique values in channel and customer_segment
df[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts()"}
